GoodwillSituationDef.label: bears a grudge
GoodwillSituationDef.description: This faction remembers what you did to them. While the grudge lasts, relations cannot be repaired past a certain point - though it will fade over time.

GoodwillSituationDef.label: desperate
GoodwillSituationDef.description: This faction is struggling to feed and defend itself. Hard times make for cold neighbours, and relations drift downward while the hardship lasts.
